Has the block around 90-01 183rd Street, Queens flooded since Hurricane Ida?
Yes. USGS surveyed 2 Hurricane Ida high-water marks within 800 m of this address; the highest stood 0.76 ft above ground; the highest water surface elevation was 48.2 ft NAVD88.
